notes: Archetype: electromagnet VSM (no squid_magnetometer alternative in enum; closest listed archetype). Model 8604 uses the 4 in (100 mm pole diameter) Model EM-4V electromagnet, not 7 in as the catalog configuration name states; the 7 in magnet is the 8607. With the 86-CRYO at ExactGAP index 5 (24 mm gap, 6.4 mm sample) the 8604 standard-pole-cap maximum field is 15.4 kOe (1.54 T). Outer dimensions are the installation footprint of electromagnet+base+head+frame (102 x 104 x 140 cm, 429 kg); console is separate (79 x 77 x 160 cm, 183 kg). Cool-down 5 min (15 min initial), LHe/LN2 transfer line from user-supplied storage Dewar (Lake Shore 1220-50 or similar); E2M mechanical pump and TPS-FRG turbo pump required but separate. Sources: 8600 catalog PDF (snapshot research/v5/cache/2dbd89b4d9c65961.txt) and product page https://www.lakeshore.com/products/categories/specification/discontinued-products/discontinued-products/8600-series-vsm (snapshot 26e6fcb5fad1801e.txt).
